sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "death"."caused_by_ship_id" AS e, "ship"."location" AS g, SUM("death"."killed") AS m1, AVG("death"."injured") AS m2 FROM "death" JOIN "ship" ON "ship"."id" = "death"."caused_by_ship_id"  GROUP BY "death"."caused_by_ship_id", "ship"."location") SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, (CAST(SUM("s1"."m1") AS REAL) / AVG("s1"."m2")) AS m3 FROM "s1"
why: total of people killed per ship within ship.location (additive)
average of people injured per ship within ship.location
coarsen to all: SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
